meta.title: Safety and Compliance
meta.description: KUL Enterprises is a licensed and insured freight carrier, USDOT {usdot}. Verify our authority and insurance filing directly with the FMCSA.

opening.heading: Everything here can be checked.
opening.lede: KUL Enterprises has been under its own authority since 2026, so there is no long safety record to point at yet.

credentials.heading: Authority and insurance
credentials.decalAlt: The KUL Enterprises LLC decal on the tractor door, {location}

items.label: USDOT number
items.note: Look this up on the FMCSA SAFER system

items.label: Insurance
items.note: Certificate issued by our agent, with your company named as holder

dashcam.caption: Eleven years driving for other carriers before the first mile under this authority.

commitments.heading: What we hold ourselves to
commitments.note: Standing policy, applying from the first load.

items.title: Maintenance
items.body: The truck is inspected before every dispatch. Anything found is fixed before the load moves, even when that costs us the load.

items.title: Hours of service
items.body: Hours are planned before dispatch. If a lane cannot be run legally inside the clock, we say so when you ask, not when we are late.

items.title: Communication
items.body: You hear about a delay from us first. The dispatch line is answered around the clock.

items.title: Cargo
items.body: Freight is secured to FMCSA standards and sealed at origin where a seal applies. The seal number goes on the paperwork so the receiver can check it.
